doc.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

title: Old Man Time session with Milt Hinton and Dizzy Gillespie
summary: He recalls the photo, the meeting at Dizzy's house and the date at Rudy Van Gelder's for Milt Hinton's record.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Tell me about playing on this particular recording with Milt.
With Milt? With the Judge? Oh that was wonderful.
There’s a great picture of you in here with—
With that cigar in his mouth.

Well that was a thrill automatically with just those two guys. The thing is, John Bunch said, “Well you guys took a picture and I went home.” John Bunch was supposed to be in this picture. Yes. Because he said, “Well Jackie, you guys took a picture and I didn’t know you guys—” I said, “Well I didn’t know either,” nobody told me until after, see I had my coat on, and they said, “Well come on.” I thought I was ready to go and they said, “Well come on we got to take a picture.” Well we had all met — Hank called and said we’re all going to go meet over at Dizzy’s house, we went over to Dizzy’s house.
